help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:123  while it remains an alias.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:124
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:125  The filters are the **shared** [`chat_stasher::selector::SelectorArgs`], not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:126  a second set of flags: the drill-down links on the page are resolved through
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:127  the same type, so a dashboard opened with `--day X` and a link carrying
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:128  `day=X` cannot mean different things.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:131  Destination to open: one name, several names separated by commas
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:132  (`--destination a,b`), or `all` for every destination the config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:133  declares. Optional when the config makes the choice unambiguous: with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:134  exactly one `[destinations.<name>]` declared it opens that one, and with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:135  several it opens the one `[native_host] destination` names — or lists
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:136  them and exits 2 when no default is recorded. An explicit `--repo` or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:137  `--destination` always wins.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:138
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:139  Naming more than one destination serves **one** dashboard with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:140  reports merged row by row: a session held by several destinations is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:141  listed once, with a badge saying how many copies there are, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:142  counts are printed both ways (distinct sessions and raw copies). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:143  destinations are read in the order named, and where two copies of a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:144  session disagree the first one named supplies the row — so the order is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:145  a choice, not an accident, and the narration prints it back.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:148  Open a named dashboard page after the server starts.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:151  Filters applied when the dashboard opens. Omit them to see the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:152  archive; every filter is also reachable as a link on the page.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:155  Do NOT launch a browser; just print the URL. Correct on headless or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:156  remote machines, where opening a browser is meaningless or wrong.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:159  Exit after this many seconds with no request (0 = never idle out,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:160  still exits on Ctrl+C).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:163  Repository path override. Not valid with more than one destination:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:164  each destination resolves its own repository from its own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:165  `[destinations.<name>]` section, and one `--repo` cannot say which.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:168  Masterkey file override. Not valid with more than one destination, for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:169  the same reason as `--repo`: each destination has its own key.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:478  The first line answers the question the timer cannot: it reads the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:479  `run-state.json` written by the last `run-once` pass. Three distinct
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:480  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:481
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:482  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:483  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:484  * no run recorded at all, or nothing has run for longer than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:485    4x `backup_interval_secs` (minimum 1 hour) -> exit 1. A dead timer
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:486    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:487    is the only thing that catches it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:488
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:489  Never prints session content: counts, timestamps and digests only.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:494  machine holds three sessions or three thousand, so the verdict never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:495  scrolls away.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:504  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:505  human lines still go to stderr). Tri-state fields are tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:506  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:507  `{"kind":"not_applicable",…}` — an unknown is never serialised as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:508  `0`, `null` or a missing field. `run_state.kind` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:509  `known` / `missing` / `unreadable`; `scanner.kind` is `ok` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:510  `failed`. `exit_semantics` documents what the exit code means.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:513  Also list archived per-machine writer versions from a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:516  Repository path override for archived writer versions.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:525  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:528  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:532  Read one session from the repository (sequence-concatenated) and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:533  report its length and sha256 without printing content. With `--all-machines`, walk
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:534  **every snapshot of every machine** cumulatively and report per-session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:535  digests.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:537  Local stage directory to compare the read against. Optional: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:538  session's bytes always come from the archive, addressed by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:539  `--machine` and `--session`, and this only adds an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:540  `expected src` sha256 computed from the shards on this machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:541  disk. It does **not** have to be the archiving machine's stage root,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:542  and a path that does not exist merely leaves that line uncomputed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:543  Ignored by `--all-machines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:546  Native session id to dump, e.g. `019bf00d-...`. Resolved against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:547  every snapshot of `--machine`, newest first, so a session reclaimed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:548  out of the stage is still readable. Ignored by `--all-machines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:551  Cross-machine merge, cumulative: for every hostname, every snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:552  (`sessions/<machine>/…`), each session's shards sequence-joined and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:553  hashed. Newest copies per shard path win; older sequences absent from
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:554  newer snapshots remain included. Prints ids, counts, lengths, and sha256 only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:557  Print full session ids in per-session rows (default: privacy-safe short ids).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:560  Show every stored shard. Default reads collapse legacy whole-content
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:561  replays while retaining verified sequence-bound captures, including
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:562  identical captured bodies. Nothing is deleted by either policy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:565  ADR-061: also emit the records the source deleted, at their
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:566  original positions, each carrying `"deleted": true`. The default
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:567  view stays the source's final state; this switch is how the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:568  deleted history — still stored, never erased — becomes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:569  reachable. Snapshot-source sessions (opencode) only; other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  harnesses ignore the switch (their bodies are growth logs).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:573  Serve this read from the local mirror copy only (W1053): the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:574  destination is never contacted — no connection is opened at all
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:575  — and every byte answers from the mirror, the body cache or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:576  rustic's local metadata cache. A file none of them holds reports
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:577  "did not finish" (exit `3`) rather than reaching for the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:578  remote, so an offline absence is unknown, never empty, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:579  report says `served from mirror`. Requires a usable mirror of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:580  the destination being read; refused before anything is read
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:581  when there is none.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:584  Machine partition to read. Uses this machine's id when available;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:585  if it is unavailable, use `--machine` explicitly. Unused by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:586  `--all-machines`, which reads every machine.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:589  Named destination from the config. Required once the config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:590  declares any destination; there is no default.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:612  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else. Tri-state
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:613  fields are tagged `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:614  / `{"kind":"not_applicable",…}` — an unknown is never serialised as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:615  `0`, `null` or a missing field. `claude.verdict.kind` is one of

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:621  Prove the archive is intact. Three independently runnable levels:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:622  l1 = rustic structure check (cheap, no payload reads), l2 = rustic content
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:623  check (downloads and re-hashes every pack), l3 = reconcile against an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:624  expected manifest derived from the sealed staging tree (per session:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:625  shard count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:627  Which level(s) to run: `l1`, `l2`, `l3` or `all`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:630  Stage directory holding the sealed shard tree (required by l3 / all).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:633  Print full session ids in L3 rows (default: privacy-safe short ids).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:636  Certify the local mirror copy instead of the destination (W1053):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:637  the destination is never contacted — the copy answers every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:638  read, and the verdict that comes back certifies **the copy**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  never the destination's repository, so it is worded that way
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:640  and the report says `served from mirror`. L1/L2 grade the copy's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:641  own integrity: packs the copy lacks its index name are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:642  copy's own finding, exit 1. L3 reconciles the stage against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:643  what the copy holds, and a session the copy never synced is an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:644  unknown about the archive — a `NOT IN THE LOCAL COPY` row and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:645  RESULT INCOMPLETE, exit 3 — never `MISSING IN ARCHIVE`, which a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:646  not-contacted destination cannot prove. An online `verify` (no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:647  switch) still never consults the copy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:650  Machine partition (default: config `machine`, else this machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:651  identity; use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:699  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:700
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:701  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:702  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:703  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:704  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:705  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:706
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:707  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:708  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:709  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:711  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:712  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:743  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:745  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:746  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:750  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:751
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:752  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:753  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:754  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:755  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:756  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:757  In a separate metadata-only run, use `--cost` to estimate the payload
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:758  size before choosing a full-text mode. `--scan` reads those payloads;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:759  `--text` uses the local index and checks that it covers the selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:760  sessions before treating zero hits as a complete answer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:761
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:762  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:763  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:765  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:766  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:768  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:769  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:770  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:771
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:772  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:773  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:775  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:776  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:777
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:778  `--surface` filters on the **observed** surface dimension (ADR-059):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:779  a session matches only if its records name the value — claude-code's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:780  Cowork transcripts record `desktop-cowork` — and a session whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:781  records carry no surface at all (the CLI library records none: an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:782  absent observation is never read as an implicit `cli`) is listed as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:783  unplaceable while the filter is active. The value must be one the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:784  registry declares in its `dimensions.surfaces` (`cli`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:785  `desktop-cowork`, …); anything else is a usage error, because a typo
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:786  named as a filter must not come back as an empty result. With the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:787  flag absent every surface is in scope and the search behaves exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:788  as it did before the dimension existed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:789
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:790  `--text` searches the local FTS5 trigram index (substring matching for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:791  runs of at least three characters). A shorter query is refused, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:792  answered: the report says `matched=unknown` and the run exits `3`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:793  `--scan` reads selected conversations and matches them as plain text
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:794  instead; it answers short queries, at the cost of reading them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:795
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:796  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:797  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:798  destination and answered for every session with no match, `3` could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:799  finish — reading it, placing every session in time, or evaluating the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:800  query — so a zero proves nothing. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:802  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:805  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / surface / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:808  Search indexed titles and user/assistant text with SQLite's trigram tokenizer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:811  Read selected sessions and perform a case-insensitive substring scan.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:814  Emit one JSON object on stdout. Metadata searches include separate
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  matched / not matched / could-not-be-placed groups; text searches
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816  carry coverage, read failures and a `query_state` for the query.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:819  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:822  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:825  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:838  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:839
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:841  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:842  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:844  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:845
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:846  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:847  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:848  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:849  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:850  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:851  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:852  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:853  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:854
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:855  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:856  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:857  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:858  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:859  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:860
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:861  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:862  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:865  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:869  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:870  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:873  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:881  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / surface / time window),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:882  resolved by the same code as `search` — a `--surface` value the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:883  registry does not declare is refused here too.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:886  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:887  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:888  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:889  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:892  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:893  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:894  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:897  ADR-061: also emit the records the source deleted, at their
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:898  original positions, each carrying `"deleted": true`. The default
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  view stays the source's final state; this switch is how the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:900  deleted history — still stored, never erased — becomes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  reachable. Snapshot-source sessions (opencode) only; other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  harnesses ignore the switch (their bodies are growth logs).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:905  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:906  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909  Write every stored shard. By default a run that byte-for-byte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:910  replays the session's complete preceding shard sequence is collapsed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  to its first copy, because that is what a re-seal leaves. The archive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  is never modified either way.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  Serve the export from the local mirror copy only (W1053): the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  destination is never contacted, and the report says
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  `served from mirror`. A selected session whose bytes the copy
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  does not hold is listed in the manifest's failed sessions with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  an unknown-worded reason and makes the run exit `3` (incomplete
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:924  — it never reads as "the archive does not have it").
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:927  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:930  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:933  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:936  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:939  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:943  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:945
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:946  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:947  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:948  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:949  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:951  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:952  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:953  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:954  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:955  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:956  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:957  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:958
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:959  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:960  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. The only
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:961  conversation text that read carries is each session's one-line label
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:962  (at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index); a session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:963  full conversation is fetched and decrypted only when you click it and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:964  then click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965  codes: 0 served the dashboard — even an archive that holds nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:966  which is served as an honest empty page rather than not starting; 3
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:967  could not finish reading (or no key), and is also the exit status after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  serving an archive that could not be read in full; 2 is a usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:970  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:971  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:973  Backfill the audit sidecar from historical sealed bodies without rewriting them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:975  Stage receiving the derived sidecar; source bodies remain untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:978  Partition owned by this writer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:981  Retained archive-wide random secret (exactly 32 bytes), outside stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:984  Scan only the stage, explicitly excluding historical destination bodies.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:994  Import an official export — or one harness's local-cache backup.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:995
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:996  Two modes share this command.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:997
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:998  **Takeout mode** (with a `<platform>` and `<export>`): archive the file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:999  byte-exact, and — where the platform's conversation import is open in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1000  this build — write one inbox bundle per conversation into a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1001  inbox. Claude's run reads `<export>` whole, stores it under
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1002  `<stage>/import-raw/<platform>/<sha256>` — a sibling of `sessions/`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1003  so it is in no session count — and writes one `chat-stasher/inbox@3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1004  `web-capture` bundle per conversation into `--inbox`, for a later
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1005  `ingest --inbox` to seal. This mode never seals, never pushes, never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1006  reads the config or a destination, and never modifies or moves the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1007  export file.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1008
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1009  Grok's run is held by this build's development import gate at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1010  **raw-export archiving only**: the export is parsed and sealed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1011  byte-exact as its own object under
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1012  `<stage>/export-files/<platform>/<sha256>/<name>`, its index row
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1013  files under `meta/<machine>/`, and **no conversation bundle is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1014  written** — the refused half is what the run says in its output.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1015  `--machine` names the partition that index row belongs to and is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1016  required for such a platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1017
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1018  Claude's `conversations.json` and Grok's `prod-grok-backend.json`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1019  have parsers in this build; naming any other platform is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1020  refusal, not a guess.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1021
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1022  **Backup-restore mode** (`--harness grok-bot --from <dir>`): feed a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1023  copied Grok Bot cache — one backup directory, several, overlapping
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1024  ones, whatever was copied aside — into the archive once, as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1025  first-class pass instead of a `[harness_roots]` workaround. Each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1026  session found in the backup is delivered through its own delivered-set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1027  identity (machine + agent uuid), so only rows that session has never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1028  archived are sealed: a backup that overlaps the live cache or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1029  earlier import adds exactly its new rows, once. Re-running the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1030  import delivers nothing. The backup is only ever read; the live cache
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1031  is never touched, and the ordinary collect after an import still
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1032  delivers only what is genuinely new. Each sealed shard's `_chat_stasher`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1033  line records that it came from a backup import, the backup directory's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1034  basename and the import time. `--dry-run` reports the per-session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1035  counts and writes nothing anywhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1036
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1037  Exit codes (both modes): `0` = everything was read to the end and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1038  imported (takeout mode: everything this build lets the run write was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1039  written) · `3` = an input was never read to the end, so nothing about
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1040  what it holds is proven · `2` = it was read and is not something this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1041  build imports, or an argument was missing or unusable · `1` = it was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1042  read, and a conversation, session, write, or the platform's import
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1043  gate refused the rest — what was written is real but the run is

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1160  Seal one file already inside our stage into the next sealed-shard slot.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1169  data.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1178  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1186  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1189  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1193  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1194  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4; ADR-060's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1195  health-gated proof).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1196
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1197  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1198  Every declared destination is first classified from its last
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1199  successful push against its degrade-after (per-destination override,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1200  else the `[reclaim]` global, default 7 days): `healthy` destinations
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1201  — and, fail-safe, a destination whose push record is unreadable —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1202  must prove; a destination whose last successful push is older than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1203  its degrade-after, or with no push on record, is degraded: not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1204  consulted for proof, listed and alarmed on every run with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1205  two-road advice (repair the push, or remove the destination from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1206  config). The command then retires the shard body once every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1207  must-prove destination proves it holds each session. Proof means
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1208  asking the archive itself — never the local cursor — for the digest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1209  triple (shard count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1210  matching it against the stage. A must-prove destination that cannot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1211  be consulted is "unproven" and blocks: it is never treated as "does
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1212  not have it". If no destination can prove at all, nothing is deleted
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1213  either — the ≥1 guard.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1214
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1215  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1216  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1217  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1218  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1219  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1220
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1221  The stage-cap alarm (`[reclaim] stage_cap_bytes`, default 10 GiB)
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1222  prints when the stage is over it, and it is an alarm only — never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1223  stop, never a forced reclaim.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1224
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1225  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1226  blocked — a must-prove destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1227  to hold a session, or no destination was healthy to prove at all, so
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1228  nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1230  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1233  Actually delete the proven shard body. Default: dry run (report only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1236  Repository path override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1239  Masterkey file override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1242  Concurrency cap override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1245  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1248  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1252  Mirror the declared destination onto this machine (ADR-062 / LM-2).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1253
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1254  A mirror is a byte-exact, file-by-file copy of one declared remote
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1255  destination's whole repository, on local disk under the data
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1256  directory, ciphertext only: `config`, `keys/`, `index/`, `snapshots/`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1257  and `data/` — everything except `locks/`, which this build never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1258  holds. Copying a repo also copies its encrypted master key, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1259  the same key the destination already uses, not a new one, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1260  copy never decrypts anything: every file except `config` is verified
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1261  by hashing the bytes against the file's own name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1262
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1263  One run is one round (W964's discipline): it lists the remote,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1264  downloads what the mirror lacks, and stops where the round's budget
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1265  `--budget-secs` (default 600) says, leaving the next round to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1266  resume from the same listing-diff — progress is recorded every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1267  round, and a stopped round is reported, never counted as a failure.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1268  The hourly pass runs the same copy after its push, inside that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1269  round's leftover budget.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1270
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1271  Before a first fill starts it estimates whether the remaining
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1272  download plus the free-disk floor (`[mirror] min_free_gib`, default
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1273  max(10 GiB, min(5% of the volume's capacity, 20 GiB))) fits the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1274  free space, and refuses with both numbers when it does not.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1275  Mid-round, free space falling below the floor pauses the copy
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1276  instead of writing toward a full disk.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1277
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1278  Exit codes: 0 = the mirror holds everything the remote listed;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1279  3 = the round stopped or refused and made no progress it did not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1280  verify (budget spent, disk floor, remote unreadable, space
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1281  pre-estimate refused — the next round resumes); 1 = a finished
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1282  read that failed (the source proved corrupt, a refused local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1283  write, the listing named a file over the whole-file bound, or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1284  the mirror volume's free space could not be queried);
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1285  2 = usage error (unconfigured, switch off, an undeclared
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1286  `mirror_of`, an uninitialised destination, or the destination's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1287  masterkey file missing on this machine or unusable) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1288  was read or written there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1293  Report the packs one destination's backend holds that **no index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1294  names** — what a push killed between its packs and its index strands —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1295  and say what the next push would do about each. Deletes nothing; there
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1296  is no mode in this build that deletes.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1297
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1298  Dry run is the only mode. `--apply` is refused with exit `3`, naming
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1299  what a safe delete would need and this build does not have: a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1300  repository-wide lock every client honors, a conditional delete carrying
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1301  an object version, and a trustworthy backend modification time to age
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1302  candidates by. "Unindexed" means no index file names the pack, not that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1303  the pack is unused — a retry can reuse one and write a snapshot that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1304  depends on it while it stays unindexed on disk — so the gap is real, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1305  a formality.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1306
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1307  Every pack it reports gets the shared interrupted-push
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1308  classification: bytes that verify complete are **stranded** — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1309  next open adopts them; bytes that cannot be read as a pack at all
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1310  are **torn debris** from an interrupted push, which belongs to no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1311  backup and can be ignored. Anything else is **unknown**, with the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1312  verifier's reason — the one state that makes the survey incomplete.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1313
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1314  Reads only: nothing is written to the repository, to an index file or to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1315  a pack. The report carries the repository fingerprint, the backend family,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1316  pack and byte totals, the unindexed packs by id prefix and size, what the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1317  next push would adopt, and any pack an index names that the backend does
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1318  not list — and never a path, host, machine, account or conversation text.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1319
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1320  Exit codes: 0 = the survey read every pack, torn debris included — it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1321  is a known state, not an unfinished read; 1 = it read everything and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1322  found an index naming a pack the backend does not list; 3 = it did
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1323  not finish reading — a pack or an index file could not be read, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1324  backend was unreachable, or `--apply` was asked for — no absence in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1325  the output proves anything; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1327  Named destination from the config. Required unless `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1330  Check the destination and stop: no repository is opened and nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1331  is deleted. This is what happens without the flag too.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1334  Refused. Present so that asking to delete gets an answer that names
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1335  what a safe delete would need, rather than an unknown-flag error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1338  Print exactly one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1339  Candidate packs carry their full id, for audit; the human report
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1340  prints a 12-character prefix.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1343  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1346  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1349  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1352  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1355  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1359  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1360  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1361
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1362  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1363  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1364  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1365  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1366
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1367  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1368  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1369  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1370  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1371  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1372  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1373
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1374  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1375  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1376
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1377  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1378  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1379  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1380  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1381  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1383  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1384  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1385  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1388  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1389  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1390  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1393  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1396  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1397  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1398  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1401  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1404  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1407  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1410  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1413  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1416  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1417  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1418  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1419  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1420  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1421  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1425  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1426
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1427  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1428  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1429  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1430  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1431  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1432
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1433  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1434  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1435  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1436  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1437  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1438
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1439  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1440  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1441  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1443  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1447  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1448
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1449  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1450  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1451  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1452  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1453  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1454  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1455
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1456  With `--rebuild --destination`, the index is rebuilt from the archive,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1457  which is all a machine whose stage is gone still needs: no source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1458  machine, and no copy of its stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1459
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1460  What that rebuild does depends on which partition is named and on
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1461  whether there is a stage to restore into, because a partition's index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1462  written by the machine that owns it (ADR-017):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1463
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1464  * **This machine's own partition, with a `--stage` directory** — every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1465    archived session is restored to a temporary child of it, the full
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1466    index is rebuilt and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1467    snapshots stay immutable; nothing is pushed until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1468    restore finish. A same-machine snapshot found before publication
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1469    restarts the rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1470  * **Any other machine, or any machine when there is no stage directory
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1471    to restore into** — the rebuild is **read-only**. That machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1472    archived sessions are read cumulatively across its snapshots and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1473    rows are written to a derived index in this machine's cache (the path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1474    is printed). The destination is not modified at all: no snapshot is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1475    appended and no path in the named machine's partition is written,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1476    because no record authorizes one machine to rewrite another's.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1477
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1478  Both modes are safe to re-run, and neither is resumable: each run starts
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1479  over. A read-only run needs the destination and the masterkey, and no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1480  `--stage` at all — which is how a machine whose stage is gone, this one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1481  included, still derives its index from the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1482
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1483  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1484  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1485  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1486  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1487  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1488
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1489  Metadata, with one declared exception: the extraction keeps a timestamp
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1490  per line and throws the line away, and — for claude-code sessions —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1491  additionally keeps the capped one-line label the dashboard lists the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1492  session under (the harness's own title, or the head of the session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1493  first user line; see the `ui` labels). That label — at most 100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1494  characters, with its provenance — is the one piece of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1495  conversation-derived text the metadata tier ever holds. Nothing else is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1496  ever kept, and the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1497
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1498  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1499  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1500  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1501  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1502  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1503  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1505  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1506  destination rebuild of **this** machine's own partition (temporary
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1507  restored shards are removed after the new snapshot is written).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1508  Omitted, or not a directory, the rebuild restores nothing and is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1509  read-only for any machine, this one included.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1512  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1513  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1514  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1517  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. Repair workflows
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1518  and investigation want the predictable hammer — every session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1519  re-derived from its bytes, whatever the previous index says — and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1520  this spelling makes that intent visible. Required for destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1521  (`--destination`/`--repo`) rebuilds. A local `--stage` build
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1522  defaults to this and only this unless `--incremental` is passed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1525  Update the index incrementally instead of rebuilding it: sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1526  whose bodies and inputs provably did not change since the last
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1527  build keep their measured row; everything else is re-derived as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1528  full rebuild would. Local `--stage` builds only; the result must
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1529  stay byte-identical to a full rebuild. `run-once` uses this path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1530  for its pre-push index build.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1533  Destination to rebuild from. Requires `--rebuild`; either this or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1534  `--repo` must be named. Appends the repaired snapshot when the named
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1535  `--machine` is this machine's own partition and `--stage` is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1536  directory; otherwise the rebuild is read-only and the result goes to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1537  a derived local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1540  Repository path override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1543  Masterkey file override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1546  Concurrency cap override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1549  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1552  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1556  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1557

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1559  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1560  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1561  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1562  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1563
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1564  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1566  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1567  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1568

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1571  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1602  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1604
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1605  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1606  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1607  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1609  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1610  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1611  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1612  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1613  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1615
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1616  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1618  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1619
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1620  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1622  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1665
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1666  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1667  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1668  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1669  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1670  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1671  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1673  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1684
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1685  The Grok Bot local cache is a bounded window, and every position
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1686  that fell out of it is gone from disk for good — but the server
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1687  still holds the conversation, and whenever the app opens one, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1688  app itself fetches the conversation's whole user-visible span into
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1689  view. `backfill grok-bot` relaunches the app with a debugging
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1690  connection that listens only on this machine, opens one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1691  conversation at a time exactly as a person clicking the sidebar
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1692  would, waits while the app loads it, and delivers the rows the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1693  archive does not already hold — marked as backfilled, through the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1694  same session identity a collect uses, so nothing is added twice and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1695  an ordinary collect after a backfill stays incremental.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1696
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1697  **The default is a dry run**: with no extra flags the same

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1699  and it only reports (per conversation: rows it would add, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1700  loaded span versus the locally held span, and the positions that

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1706  can reach it. The app is restored to a normal launch at the end of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1707  every run — including Ctrl-C, where what has been delivered stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1708  delivered. The interior positions the vendor's service never sends

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1837
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1838  **The default is the dry run, and this build has no other mode.**
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1839  The destructive purge — the exclusive maintenance gate, the tombstone
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1840  publication barrier, snapshot rewrite, forget and prune (ADR-046
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1841  draft Phase 3) — is not implemented. `--confirm SESSION` exists so

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1845

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1848  in other partitions are not the target. Destinations are explicit:

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1859  and an absence proves nothing. `1` is not used by this command.
