help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1867  Named destination to inspect, repeatable. Required unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1868  `--all-destinations` is given (or a single-destination config).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1871  Inspect every destination the config declares. Explicit: with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1872  no `--destination` and no `--all-destinations` the command is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1873  usage error, because there is no implicit destination set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1876  Preview and stop. This is also what happens without the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1877  flag; the flag exists so a script can say what it expected.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1880  Real execution — refused in this build. The value must name the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1881  exact session being confirmed; anything else is a usage error
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1882  either way.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1885  Print exactly one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1888  Repository path override (single-destination mode only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1891  Masterkey file override (single-destination mode only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1894  Concurrency cap override (single-destination mode only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1897  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable (single-destination mode
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1898  only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1901  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1905  Redact an archived session by cutting it at a cutoff and re-sealing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1906  user-edited content as a new version. **Not implemented; refused.**
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1907
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1908  The command surface exists because the design names it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1909  (`docs-dev/redaction-and-recollection.md`, ADR-046 draft §5):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1910  redaction is the destructive transaction of a later phase — record
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1911  the cutoff tombstone, remove the old scoped occurrences from stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1912  and every destination, then seal the replacement. Until that phase
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1913  ships, asking for it gets this refusal rather than an unknown-flag
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1914  error, and nothing is read or changed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1915
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1916  Exit codes: `2` always — a deliberate refusal, not a failure to run:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1917  the operation does not exist in this build.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1919  Exact session id to redact. Never prefix-matched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1921  Machine partition of the target identity. Default: this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1922  machine's partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1928  `cache` subcommands.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1931  Delete every cached body block.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1932
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1933  Only the cache directory is touched — never the archive, never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1934  destination, never a key. Entries are re-fetched from the destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1935  the next time a session is read.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1941  Destination to index. Required unless an explicit repository is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1944  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1947  Masterkey file override (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1950  Concurrency cap override (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1953  Backend option key=value, repeatable (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1956  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1963  Read changed sessions from the archive and update the local FTS index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1965  Validate and count indexed sessions without contacting the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1967  Delete this destination's marked local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2073  The parameters of the remote step, exactly as the caller supplied them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2074
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2075  Every field here is either a name or a location. **No field can carry a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2076  secret**, and that is the point of the shape rather than an accident of it:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2077  the two credential fields are the *names of environment variables*, which the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2078  wizard writes into the config as `env:NAME` and never resolves itself. So a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2079  secret cannot reach the config file as plaintext, and it cannot reach
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2080  `argv` — where it would be captured by the process list and by any log that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2081  echoes the command — because there is no flag that would accept one.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2084  Which recipe to write.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2087  SFTP: `ssh://<host>:<port>`. S3: the service endpoint, e.g.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2088  `https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2091  SFTP only: the ssh user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2094  SFTP only: the private key to authenticate with. Optional — leaving it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2095  out lets the backend use the ssh agent and its own default keys, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2096  a real configuration rather than a gap.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2099  S3 only: the bucket (or container) the repository lives in.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2102  S3 only: the region. R2 is single-region and names it `auto`; another
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2103  S3-compatible service names its own.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2106  Both kinds: the prefix inside the account/bucket that the repository
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2107  lives under. Optional, and omitted rather than defaulted: a prefix the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2108  user did not choose would put their archive somewhere they did not name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2111  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the access key
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2112  id. Not the key id itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2115  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the secret
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2116  access key. Not the secret.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2119  Declare that this host's key was checked out of band, which authorizes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2120  recording it in `~/.ssh/known_hosts`. A declaration, not a verification:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2121  nothing here, and nothing anywhere else, can check that the comparison
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2122  happened. Without it the wizard stops at an unknown host and writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:2123  nothing (ADR-039, rejected option E).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:348  Filters shared by `search` and (later) `export`, flattened into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:349  command's argument struct so the two commands cannot drift apart.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:350
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:351  Conflicts are expressed here rather than re-implemented per command:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:352  mixing a local-day flag with a unix-seconds flag is a usage error
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:353  regardless of which command asked.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:356  Match sessions whose id starts with this prefix.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:359  Match one machine partition exactly.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:362  Match these harnesses, comma-separated (e.g. `--harness claude-code,codex`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:363  The harness is the leading `.`/`~` segment of the archived session id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:366  Match an observed runtime surface (ADR-059): the session's records
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:367  must name this exact value in their `surface` dimension. `cli` and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:368  `desktop-cowork` are the claude-code values; the full vocabulary is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:369  the registry's `dimensions.surfaces` union, validated by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:370  [`Self::resolve_validated`] — an unknown value is a usage error,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:371  never an empty result. A session whose records carry no surface at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:372  all (claude-code's CLI library records none) is listed as unplaceable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/selector.rs:373  while this filter is active: an absent observation is not a value.
